mainEntity.name: Are there beginner-friendly team training options available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Cave Training offers beginner-friendly team training options. Our coaches are skilled at providing modifications and alternative exercises within the group setting, ensuring that newcomers can safely participate and build a strong foundation. A key decision factor when starting is to communicate any previous injuries or fitness concerns to your coach, allowing them to better guide you through appropriate movements and scaling options.
